arxiv-2109-02205.title: Tensor force role in β \beta decays analyzed within the Gogny-interaction shell model
arxiv-2109-02205.creator: B. Dai, B. S. Hu, Y. Z. Ma, J. G. Li, S. M. Wang, C. W. Johnson, F. R. Xu
arxiv-2109-02205.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by B. Dai, B. S. Hu, Y. Z. Ma, J. G. Li, S. M. Wang, C. W. Johnson, F. R. Xu. Background The half-life of the famous 14 C β \beta decay is anomalously long, with different mechanisms: the tensor force, cross-shell mixing, and three-body forces, proposed to explain the cancellations that lead to a small transition matrix element. Purpose We revisit and analyze the role of the tensor force for the β \beta decay of 14 C as well as of neighboring isotopes.

arxiv-2208-03495.title: HARDY INEQUALITIES ON CONSTAN-ORDER NONCOMMUTATIVE VILENKIN GROUPS
arxiv-2208-03495.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . In this note we extend several integral inequalities to the context of noncommutative Vilenkin groups. We prove some sharp weak and strong type estimates for the Hardy operator and the Hardy-Littlewood-Pólya operator on constant-order noncommutative Vilenkin groups.

arxiv-2301-01655.description: Abstract . Objective: To present the first 3D CGO-based absolute EIT reconstructions from experimental tank data. Approach: CGO-based methods for absolute EIT imaging are compared to traditional TV regularized non-linear least squares reconstruction methods. arxiv-2310-14817.title: Text2Topic: Multi-Label Text Classification System for Efficient Topic Detection in User Generated Content with Zero-Shot Capabilities
arxiv-2310-14817.creator: Fengjun Wang, Moran Beladev, Ofri Kleinfeld, Elina Frayerman,Tal Shachar, Eran Fainman, Karen Lastmann Assaraf, Sarai Mizrachi, Benjamin Wang Booking.com{fengjun.wang, moran.beladev, ofri.kleinfeld, elina.frayerman, tal.shachar,eran.fainman, karen.lastmannassaraf, sarai.mizrachi, benjamin.wang }@boo
arxiv-2310-14817.description: Abstract Multi-label text classification is a critical task in the industry. It helps to extract structured information from large amount of textual data. We propose Text to Topic (Text2Topic), which achieves high multi-label classification performance by employing a Bi-Encoder Transformer architecture that utilizes concatenation, subtraction, and multiplication of embeddings on both text and topic.

arxiv-2405-08714.title: On Holographic Vacuum Misalignment
arxiv-2405-08714.creator: Daniel Elander, Ali Fatemiabhari, Maurizio Piai
arxiv-2405-08714.description: Abstract We develop a bottom-up holographic model that provides the dual description of a strongly coupled field theory, in which the spontaneous breaking of an approximate global symmetry yields the S ​ O ​ ( 5 ) / S ​ O ​ ( 4 ) SO(5)/SO(4) coset relevant to minimal composite-Higgs models.

arxiv-2406-19320.title: Efficient World Models with Context-Aware Tokenization
arxiv-2406-19320.creator: Vincent Micheli, Eloi Alonso, François Fleuret
arxiv-2406-19320.description: Abstract Scaling up deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods presents a significant challenge. Following developments in generative modelling, model-based RL positions itself as a strong contender. Recent advances in sequence modelling have led to effective transformer-based world models, albeit at the price of heavy computations due to the long sequences of tokens required to accurately simulate environments.

arxiv-2508-05173.title: Near Optimal Inference for the Best-Performing Algorithm
arxiv-2508-05173.creator: Amichai Painsky
arxiv-2508-05173.description: Abstract Consider a collection of competing machine learning algorithms. Given their performance on a benchmark of datasets, we would like to identify the best performing algorithm. Specifically, which algorithm is most likely to rank highest on a future, unseen dataset. A natural approach is to select the algorithm that demonstrates the best performance on the benchmark.

arxiv-2510-18943.title: Muon trident process at far-forward LHC detectors
arxiv-2510-18943.creator: Reinaldo Francener, Victor P. Gonçalves, Gabriel Rabelo-Soares
arxiv-2510-18943.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Reinaldo Francener, Victor P. Gonçalves, Gabriel Rabelo-Soares. The electromagnetic production of a dilepton pair in the muon - ion scattering, usually denoted muon trident process, is investigated considering the feasibility of studying processes induced by muons at LHC using its far-forward detectors.

pmc-10571002.title: Direct Writing of a Titania Foam in Microgravity for Photocatalytic Applications
pmc-10571002.creator: G Jacob Cordonier, Kyleigh Anderson, Ronan Butts, Ross O’Hara, Renee Garneau, Nathanael Wimer, John M Kuhlman, Konstantinos A Sierros
pmc-10571002.description: This work explores the potential for additive manufacturing to be used to fabricate ultraviolet light-blocking or photocatalytic materials with in situ resource utilization, using a titania foam as a model system. Direct foam writing was used to deposit titania-based foam lines in microgravity using parabolic flight.

pmc-13170617.title: Anatomically Accurate 3D-Printed Thoracic Model With Artificial Skin for Chest Drainage Training
pmc-13170617.creator: Rene D Mileva-Popova, Konstantinos Papadakis, Krasimir K Yanev, Andrey D Petrov, Todor G Bogdanov
pmc-13170617.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simulation-based training is an essential component of modern medical education, particularly for invasive procedures such as chest tube insertion and thoracentesis, where incorrect technique may lead to serious complications. The aim of this technical report is to describe the development and implementation of an anatomically accurate thoracic training model created using computed tomography (CT) data, three-dimensional (3D) printing, and silicone molding technologies.

pmc-13299990.title: The association between osteosarcopenia and the risk of heart failure in patients with atrial fibrillation: a prospective cohort study from UK biobank
pmc-13299990.creator: K Y Lee, T M Rhee, E K Choi, J M Choi, H J Ahn, S R Lee, S Oh, G Lip
pmc-13299990.description: BackgroundOsteosarcopenia (OS), characterized by low muscle mass and bone density, is linked to cardiovascular disease. Atrial fibrillation (AF), a major cardiovascular condition, is strongly associated with heart failure (HF). However, the relationship between OS and incident HF in patients with AF remains unclear.PurposeTo investigate the association between OS and incident HF in patients with AF.

pmc-13643562.creator: Emily Morris, Ali Roomi, Massimiliano Costello, Russell Franks, Joanna Lim, Saul Myerson, James D. Newton, Elizabeth Orchard, Sam Dawkins, Thomas J. Cahill
pmc-13643562.description: BackgroundSevere tricuspid regurgitation (TR) carries high morbidity and is often undertreated in patients with complex congenital heart disease and prohibitive surgical risk.Case SummaryA 33-year-old woman with complex congenital heart disease and multiple prior surgeries presented with progressive right-sided heart failure and torrential TR.
